releases.notes:
### Battlecards 0.6.2 is unboxed!

Content Changes
'Extremely Strong' (11) damage renamed to 'Great' damage
Adds Arson, Caltrops, Fire Trap, and Flaming Bolt cards to the pillager's Way of Reaping I booster pack.
-Arson: Q: Arrow deals Weak projectile/fire damage and generates 2 mana. C(9): Arrow deals Great projectile/fire damage and spreads fire in wide area.
-Caltrops: Q: Three Weak traps generate 2 mana each. C(3): Six Strong traps hobble victims for a short time.
-Fire Trap: Q: Weak fire trap generates 2 mana for each target in range. C(4): Strong, four block radius fire trap ignites ground.
-Flaming Bolt: Q: Arrow deals Weak projectile/fire damage and generates 2 mana. C(5): Arrow deals Very Strong projectile/fire damage and sets fire to target.
Adjusted projectile speed of Overpenetration for consistency with other Way of Reaping projectiles.

Datapack Changes
BlocksInDiskEffect and SnapBlockPosToSurfaceEffect effects now accept 'direction' and 'directionRelativeToEntity' arguments
-'direction' is a string which determines the axis perpendicular to BlocksInDiskEffect's selection, and the direction of movement for SnapBlockPosToSurface. "down" by default.
-directionRelativeToEntity is a boolean which determines if the effect's direction changes based on the facing of the target entity. For example, Arson uses this to makes planes of fire along both flat and vertical surfaces depending on the projectile's facing.

Bugfixes
Crash from damage effects with invalid damage types.
Entity in Range effects wouldn't tell one-time effects who to target.

releases.notes:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tigereye504/BattleCards/commits/v0.5.4

To get started, make a deck box out of a boat of paper.
Either find card packs by killing common mobs, or make some using 3 paper in the central column of a crafting table.
Quick card actions are used on right click, charged card action on held right click. Charged actions require mana made by quick actions.
Cards can be used outside of decks, but have long cooldowns and high mana costs.
Sleeves are made with one glass pane sandwiched by paper,iron,gold,diamond,emerald,redstone blocks, or glowstone blocks. Cards are sleeved by putting a card in the off hand and the sleeve in the main hand. They make cards significantly more effective.
Decks function like bundles that only hold cards, and can be right clicked to enter an active state and override your hotbar.
Unwanted cards can be torn up into Cardfetti, which can be burnt as fuel or used to boost your luck in future booster pack uses. It is compactable.
